---
title: "Surface Metrics"
---

1. Calculate 3 different patch metrics from those in the example. Paste a map of one of them in the Slack Channel.

2. Calculate 3 different class metrics from those in the example. Paste a histogram for one of the metrics in the Slack Channel.

3. Combine your 3 patchmetrics into a single matrix and estimate the correlation between them (use `show_correlation`) and paste them in the slack channel.
